PLAN "Postpartum Return to Exercise: 10 Weeks Postpartum"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Safe return to exercise with pelvic floor awareness"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Rebuild aerobic base and movement quality"

PHASES
  PHASE "Week 1: Movement Reacclimation" (1 week):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday mobility 30m "Gentle movement and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 1m
      DAY Wednesday mobility 30m "Gentle movement and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 1m
      DAY Friday mobility 30m "Gentle movement and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
          spinal_twist 1m

  PHASE "Week 2: Light Loading and Stability" (1 week):
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday strength 35m "Lower body and core stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday strength 35m "Upper body and postural":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday strength 35m "Full body integration":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x25 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2m
          spinal_twist 2m

  PHASE "Week 3: Progressive Loading and Movement Variety" (1 week):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday strength 40m "Lower body emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday strength 40m "Upper body and core":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday strength 40m "Full body with conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          forward_fold 2m

  PHASE "Week 4: Consolidation and Baseline Building" (1 week):
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday strength 45m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Wednesday strength 45m "Upper body and postural strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday strength 45m "Full body integration":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x40 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 3m
          forward_fold 2m
          spinal_twist 2m

Rebuild aerobic base and movement quality
